Message: Time thoda kam reh gaya hai — aapke kundli mein ek khaas cheez dikh rahi hai Moon in Revati nakshatra ke baare mein, thoda aur time hoga toh wo bhi bata sakti hoon.
Dursi shadi ka yog bhi hai ji. Rahu 6th house mein baitha hai.
dusari shyadi hai mere life me
Aapke 7th house mein Venus baitha hai ji. Partner thoda moody ho sakta hai.
Theek hai Imran ji, samajh gayi.
Imran ji, aapki kundli mein Jupiter ki drishti hai. Shubh samay paas aa raha hai.
Aapki kundli mein vivah yog ban raha hai. Shaadi ke baare mein kuch aur jaan na hai?
thik hai shadi ke baare me batao
Karz ya finance ke baare mein main nahi bata sakti.
Imran ji, main sirf shaadi aur rishton ke baare mein baat karti hoon.
meri dob dekha kar batao mera karj kabhi katam hoga
Namaste Imran ji, aapka swagat hai.
